parts.text:
The student adds some solid H to dilute nitric acid.
A colourless solution and a colourless gas are formed.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:

A white precipitate is formed.

A white precipitate forms.
The precipitate is soluble in excess aqueous ammonia, giving a colourless solution.
Identify the cation (positive ion) present in solid H.
